theorem MvPolynomial.exists_separated_representation_indep_le_degreeOf {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_4} [Field K] (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ Unit) K) {d : ℕ} (hd : degreeOf (Sum.inr ()) P ≤ d) :
∃ (r : ℕ) (φ : Fin r → MvPolynomial σ K) (ψ : Fin r → MvPolynomial Unit K), r ≤ d + 1 ∧ LinearIndependent K φ ∧ LinearIndependent K ψ ∧ (∀ (k : Fin r) (x : σ), degreeOf x (φ k) ≤ degreeOf (Sum.inl x) P) ∧ (∀ (k : Fin r) (y : Unit), degreeOf y (ψ k) ≤ degreeOf (Sum.inr y) P) ∧ P = ∑ k : Fin r, (rename Sum.inl) (φ k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ k)

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_separated_representation_indep_card_le {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {K : Type u_4} [Field K] [DecidableEq τ] (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) K) :
∃ (r : ℕ) (φ : Fin r → MvPolynomial σ K) (ψ : Fin r → MvPolynomial τ K), r ≤ (Finset.image (fun (n : σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ) => (Finsupp.sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp n).2) P.support).card ∧ LinearIndependent K φ ∧ LinearIndependent K ψ ∧ (∀ (k : Fin r) (x : σ), degreeOf x (φ k) ≤ degreeOf (Sum.inl x) P) ∧ (∀ (k : Fin r) (y : τ), degreeOf y (ψ k) ≤ degreeOf (Sum.inr y) P) ∧ P = ∑ k : Fin r, (rename Sum.inl) (φ k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ k)

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_separated_representation_indep {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {K : Type u_4} [Field K] (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) K) :
∃ (r : ℕ) (φ : Fin r → MvPolynomial σ K) (ψ : Fin r → MvPolynomial τ K), LinearIndependent K φ ∧ LinearIndependent K ψ ∧ P = ∑ k : Fin r, (rename Sum.inl) (φ k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ k)

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_indep_representation {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {K : Type u_4} [Field K] (r : ℕ) (φ : Fin r → MvPolynomial σ K) (ψ : Fin r → MvPolynomial τ K) :
∃ (r' : ℕ) (φ' : Fin r' → MvPolynomial σ K) (ψ' : Fin r' → MvPolynomial τ K), r' ≤ r ∧ LinearIndependent K φ' ∧ LinearIndependent K ψ' ∧ (∀ (D : σ → ℕ), (∀ (k : Fin r) (x : σ), degreeOf x (φ k) ≤ D x) → ∀ (k : Fin r') (x : σ), degreeOf x (φ' k) ≤ D x) ∧ (∀ (D : τ → ℕ), (∀ (k : Fin r) (y : τ), degreeOf y (ψ k) ≤ D y) → ∀ (k : Fin r') (y : τ), degreeOf y (ψ' k) ≤ D y) ∧ ∑ k : Fin r, (rename Sum.inl) (φ k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ k) = ∑ k : Fin r', (rename Sum.inl) (φ' k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ' k)

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_shorter_of_phi_dep {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {K : Type u_4} [Field K] {n : ℕ} (φ : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial σ K) (ψ : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial τ K) (h : ¬LinearIndependent K φ) :
∃ (φ' : Fin n → MvPolynomial σ K) (ψ' : Fin n → MvPolynomial τ K), (∀ (D : σ → ℕ), (∀ (k : Fin (n + 1)) (x : σ), degreeOf x (φ k) ≤ D x) → ∀ (k : Fin n) (x : σ), degreeOf x (φ' k) ≤ D x) ∧ (∀ (D : τ → ℕ), (∀ (k : Fin (n + 1)) (y : τ), degreeOf y (ψ k) ≤ D y) → ∀ (k : Fin n) (y : τ), degreeOf y (ψ' k) ≤ D y) ∧ ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), (rename Sum.inl) (φ k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ k) = ∑ k : Fin n, (rename Sum.inl) (φ' k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ' k)

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_shorter_of_psi_dep {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {K : Type u_4} [Field K] {n : ℕ} (φ : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial σ K) (ψ : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial τ K) (h : ¬LinearIndependent K ψ) :
∃ (φ' : Fin n → MvPolynomial σ K) (ψ' : Fin n → MvPolynomial τ K), (∀ (D : σ → ℕ), (∀ (k : Fin (n + 1)) (x : σ), degreeOf x (φ k) ≤ D x) → ∀ (k : Fin n) (x : σ), degreeOf x (φ' k) ≤ D x) ∧ (∀ (D : τ → ℕ), (∀ (k : Fin (n + 1)) (y : τ), degreeOf y (ψ k) ≤ D y) → ∀ (k : Fin n) (y : τ), degreeOf y (ψ' k) ≤ D y) ∧ ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), (rename Sum.inl) (φ k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ k) = ∑ k : Fin n, (rename Sum.inl) (φ' k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ' k)

theorem MvPolynomial.degreeOf_factor_le_of_indep {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [DecidableEq σ] {r : ℕ} (φ : Fin r → MvPolynomial σ R) (ψ : Fin r → MvPolynomial τ R) (hψ : LinearIndependent R ψ) (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) (hP : P = ∑ k : Fin r, (rename Sum.inl) (φ k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ k)) (j : σ) (k : Fin r) :
degreeOf j (φ k) ≤ degreeOf (Sum.inl j) P

theorem MvPolynomial.card_image_snd_le_of_degreeOf {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] {P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ Unit) R} {d : ℕ} (hd : degreeOf (Sum.inr ()) P ≤ d) :
(Finset.image (fun (n : σ ⊕ Unit →₀ ℕ) => (Finsupp.sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp n).2) P.support).card ≤ d + 1

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_separated_representation_fin_right {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [DecidableEq τ] (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) :
∃ (r : ℕ) (φ : Fin r → MvPolynomial σ R) (ψ : Fin r → MvPolynomial τ R), r = (Finset.image (fun (n : σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ) => (Finsupp.sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp n).2) P.support).card ∧ (∀ (k : Fin r) (x : σ), degreeOf x (φ k) ≤ degreeOf (Sum.inl x) P) ∧ (∀ (k : Fin r) (y : τ), degreeOf y (ψ k) ≤ degreeOf (Sum.inr y) P) ∧ P = ∑ k : Fin r, (rename Sum.inl) (φ k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ k)

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_separated_representation_monomial_right {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [DecidableEq τ] (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) :
∃ (φ : (τ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R), (∀ (j : τ →₀ ℕ) (x : σ), degreeOf x (φ j) ≤ degreeOf (Sum.inl x) P) ∧ P = ∑ j ∈ Finset.image (fun (n : σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ) => (Finsupp.sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp n).2) P.support, (rename Sum.inl) (φ j) * (rename Sum.inr) ((monomial j) 1)

theorem MvPolynomial.degreeOf_monomial_le {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ) (a : R) :
degreeOf i ((monomial s) a) ≤ s i

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_separated_representation_fin {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) :
∃ (r : ℕ) (φ : Fin r → MvPolynomial σ R) (ψ : Fin r → MvPolynomial τ R), LinearIndependent R φ ∧ P = ∑ k : Fin r, (rename Sum.inl) (φ k) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ k)

theorem MvPolynomial.linearIndependent_monomial {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (t : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) :
LinearIndependent R fun (i : ↑t) => (monomial ↑i) 1

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_separated_representation_monomial {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) :
∃ (t : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)) (ψ : (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial τ R), P = ∑ i ∈ t, (rename Sum.inl) ((monomial i) 1) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ i)

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_separated_representation {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) :
∃ (s : Finset (σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ)) (φ : (σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R) (ψ : (σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial τ R), P = ∑ n ∈ s, (rename Sum.inl) (φ n) * (rename Sum.inr) (ψ n)

theorem MvPolynomial.monomial_sumElim_eq' {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (i : σ →₀ ℕ) (j : τ →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
(monomial (i.sumElim j)) c = (rename Sum.inl) ((monomial i) 1) * (rename Sum.inr) ((monomial j) c)

theorem MvPolynomial.monomial_sumElim_eq {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (i : σ →₀ ℕ) (j : τ →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
(monomial (i.sumElim j)) c = (rename Sum.inl) ((monomial i) c) * (rename Sum.inr) ((monomial j) 1)
